components.name: nonlinear target defect bundle and A4 escalation gate
components.project_addition: For arbitrary deterministic targets under a finite collapse, uses the exact coarse-to-target support correspondence as the canonical MAY-level defect bundle and proves exact relational composition. Group/module compression is admitted only when all kernel-translation target derivatives are basepoint-independent, yielding a homomorphism and uniform coset defect. Common support cosets alone do not imply action/witness homogeneity. Richer COUNT/LABEL/witness semantics escalate to the typed weighted-relation compiler.
